question.text:
A gas undergoes physical adsorption on a surface and follows the given Freundlich adsorption isotherm equation
xm=kp0.5
Adsorption of the gas increases with:

options.text: Decrease in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math> and increase in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>
Increase in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math> and decrease in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>
Increase in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math> and increase in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>
Decrease in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math> and decrease in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>

solution.text:
xm=kp 0.5
Physical adsorption increases with decrease in Temperature.
According to relation xm↑ on P↑
So adsorption increases on increasing pressure.
